en.content: Which of the following ketone will NOT give enamine on treatment with secondary amines? [where t-Bu is C(CH3)3]
en.explanation:
In order to form enamine from the reaction of carbonyl compound with amine, the carbonyl compound must have -hydrogen.


Along with this, due to steric crowding by t-Bu group, it is difficult for amine to attack on this compound.
